description.value: Mi Tierra Latina is a specialty Latin American grocery store stocking products from nine countries including Colombia, Mexico, Brazil, Peru, and Venezuela. It carries a wide range of authentic staples — tortillas, chiles, sauces, rice and beans, coffees, and sweets — that would be difficult to find at a mainstream supermarket. The store also operates an online shop with delivery across Vancouver and in-store pickup.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Mi Tierra Latina is a real, active Latin American specialty grocery store running on Shopify with an extensive product catalogue (beverages, canned food, dairy, snacks, etc. from multiple Latin American countries). Two significant discrepancies exist: OSM spells the name 'Mi Terra Latina' while the website consistently uses 'Mi Tierra Latina'; and the OSM address (763 Sixth Street, V3L 3C6) is a New Westminster postal code, while the website's front page text references a location 'in Downtown Vancouver, in the heart of Davie Village' — the Locations subpage was not captured in full, so the Sixth Street address cannot be confirmed as a current physical location. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM has 'Mi Terra Latina' but website consistently uses 'Mi Tierra Latina'.

Address/community conflict: V3L 3C6 is a New Westminster postal code on Sixth Street, but the OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' and the website front page references a Downtown Vancouver/Davie Village location — these three do not agree.
The website Locations subpage was not captured in full; it is unclear whether 763 Sixth Street is a valid current physical store address or a different/former location.
